172    private boolean isKeepAlive() {
173        boolean hasKeepAliveFile = Files.isRegularFile(getKeepAliveFile(), LinkOption.NOFOLLOW_LINKS);
174        return hasKeepAliveFile || isStartExplicitlyInvoked();
175    }
176
177    private boolean isStartExplicitlyInvoked() {
178        return mavenSession.getGoals()
179            .stream()
180            .anyMatch(goal -> goal.equals("mn:" + StartTestResourcesServerMojo.NAME));
181    }
182
183    /**
184     * Starts the Test Resources Service.
185     */
186    public void start() throws MojoExecutionException {
187        if (!enabled) {
188            return;
189        }
190        try {
191            doStart();
192        } catch (Exception e) {
193            throw new MojoExecutionException("Unable to start test resources server", e);
194        }
195    }
196
197    private void doStart() throws IOException {
198        var accessToken = UUID.randomUUID().toString();
199        Path buildDir = buildDirectory.toPath();
200        Path serverSettingsDirectory = getServerSettingsDirectory();
201        var serverStarted = new AtomicBoolean(false);
202        var serverFactory = new DefaultServerFactory(log, toolchainManager, mavenSession, serverStarted, testResourcesVersion, debugServer, foreground, !isKeepAlive(), testResourcesSystemProperties);
203        if (shared) {
204            try (var ignored = sharedServerLock(serverSettingsDirectory)) {
205                doStart(accessToken, buildDir, serverSettingsDirectory, serverFactory, serverStarted);
206            }
207            return;
208        }
209        doStart(accessToken, buildDir, serverSettingsDirectory, serverFactory, serverStarted);
210    }
211
212    private void doStart(String accessToken,
213                         Path buildDir,
214                         Path serverSettingsDirectory,
215                         ServerFactory serverFactory,
216                         AtomicBoolean serverStarted) throws IOException {
217        Optional<ServerSettings> sessionSharedServerSettings = findSessionSharedServer(serverSettingsDirectory);
218        if (sessionSharedServerSettings.isPresent()) {
219            ServerSettings serverSettings = sessionSharedServerSettings.get();
220            writePortFile(buildDir.resolve(PORT_FILE_NAME), serverSettings.getPort());
221            registerSharedServerUse(serverSettingsDirectory, serverSettings.getPort(), false);
222            logSharedMode(serverSettingsDirectory);
223            writeSharedScopeConfiguration();
224            setSystemProperties(serverSettings);
225            return;
226        }
227        Optional<ServerSettings> existingServerSettings = findReachableRecordedServer(serverSettingsDirectory);
228        if (existingServerSettings.isPresent()) {
229            useServerSettings(buildDir, serverSettingsDirectory, existingServerSettings.get(), false);
230            return;
231        }
232        Optional<ServerSettings> optionalServerSettings = startOrConnectToExistingServer(accessToken, buildDir, serverSettingsDirectory, serverFactory);
233        if (optionalServerSettings.isEmpty()) {
234            return;
235        }
236        ServerSettings serverSettings = optionalServerSettings.get();
237        useServerSettings(buildDir, serverSettingsDirectory, serverSettings, serverStarted.get());
238        if (serverStarted.get() && isKeepAlive()) {
239            log.info("Micronaut Test Resources service is started in the background. To stop it, run the following command: 'mvn mn:" + StopTestResourcesServerMojo.NAME + "'");
240        }
241    }
242
243    private Optional<ServerSettings> findSessionSharedServer(Path serverSettingsDirectory) {
244        if (!shared || mavenProject == null) {
245            return Optional.empty();
246        }
247        synchronized (SESSION_STATE_MONITOR) {
248            SessionState sessionState = SESSION_STATES.get(mavenSession);
249            if (sessionState == null) {
250                return Optional.empty();
251            }
252            SharedServerState sharedServerState = sessionState.sharedServers.get(normalize(serverSettingsDirectory));
253            if (sharedServerState == null) {
254                return Optional.empty();
255            }
256            return ServerUtils.readServerSettings(serverSettingsDirectory)
257                .filter(settings -> settings.getPort() == sharedServerState.port);
258        }
259    }
260
261    private Optional<ServerSettings> findReachableRecordedServer(Path serverSettingsDirectory) {
262        return ServerUtils.readServerSettings(serverSettingsDirectory)
263            .filter(serverSettings -> explicitPort == null || serverSettings.getPort() == explicitPort)
264            .filter(this::isReusableTestResourcesServer);
265    }
266
267    private boolean isReusableTestResourcesServer(ServerSettings serverSettings) {
268        HttpURLConnection connection = null;
269        try {
270            var url = URI.create("http://localhost:" + serverSettings.getPort() + TEST_RESOURCES_REQUIREMENTS_ENTRIES_PATH).toURL();
271            connection = (HttpURLConnection) url.openConnection();
272            connection.setConnectTimeout(SERVER_PROBE_TIMEOUT_MS);
273            connection.setReadTimeout(SERVER_PROBE_TIMEOUT_MS);
274            connection.setRequestMethod("GET");
275            connection.setRequestProperty("Accept", "application/json");
276            String accessToken = serverSettings.getAccessToken().orElse(null);
277            if (accessToken != null) {
278                connection.setRequestProperty(ACCESS_TOKEN_HEADER, accessToken);
279            }
280            if (connection.getResponseCode() != HttpURLConnection.HTTP_OK || !isJsonContentType(connection.getContentType())) {
281                return false;
282            }
283            try (InputStream input = connection.getInputStream()) {
284                return isJsonStringArray(new String(input.readAllBytes(), StandardCharsets.UTF_8));
285            }
286        } catch (IOException _) {
287            return false;
288        } finally {
289            if (connection != null) {
290                connection.disconnect();
291            }
292        }
293    }
294
295    private static boolean isJsonContentType(String contentType) {
296        if (contentType == null) {
297            return false;
298        }
299        return contentType.equals("application/json") || contentType.startsWith("application/json;");
300    }
301
302    private static boolean isJsonStringArray(String body) {
303        String trimmed = body.trim();
304        return trimmed.length() >= 2 && trimmed.charAt(0) == '[' && trimmed.charAt(trimmed.length() - 1) == ']';
305    }
306
307    private void useServerSettings(Path buildDir, Path serverSettingsDirectory, ServerSettings serverSettings, boolean serverStarted) throws IOException {
308        writePortFile(buildDir.resolve(PORT_FILE_NAME), serverSettings.getPort());
309        boolean sessionOwnedSharedServer = shared && registerSharedServerUse(serverSettingsDirectory, serverSettings.getPort(), serverStarted);
310        if (shared) {
311            logSharedMode(serverSettingsDirectory);
312            writeSharedScopeConfiguration();
313        }
314        setSystemProperties(serverSettings);
315        if (!serverStarted && !sessionOwnedSharedServer) {
316            // A server was already listening before this build started, so leave it running.
317            createKeepAliveFile();
318        }
319    }
320
321    /**
322     * Computes the system properties to set for the test resources client to be able to connect to the server.
323     *
324     * @param serverSettings The server settings
325     * @return The system properties
326     */
327    public Map<String, String> computeSystemProperties(ServerSettings serverSettings) {
328        var systemProperties = new HashMap<String, String>(3);
329        String uri = String.format("http://localhost:%d", serverSettings.getPort());
330        systemProperties.put(TEST_RESOURCES_PROP_SERVER_URI, uri);
331        serverSettings.getAccessToken().ifPresent(accessToken -> systemProperties.put(TEST_RESOURCES_PROP_ACCESS_TOKEN, accessToken));
332        serverSettings.getClientTimeout().ifPresent(timeout -> systemProperties.put(TEST_RESOURCES_PROP_CLIENT_READ_TIMEOUT, String.valueOf(timeout)));
333        return systemProperties;
334    }
335
336    private void setSystemProperties(ServerSettings serverSettings) {
337        computeSystemProperties(serverSettings).forEach(System::setProperty);
338    }

340    private static void writePortFile(Path file, int port) throws IOException {
341        Files.createDirectories(file.getParent());
342        Files.writeString(file, Integer.toString(port));
343    }

345    private Optional<ServerSettings> startOrConnectToExistingServer(String accessToken, Path buildDir, Path serverSettingsDirectory, ServerFactory serverFactory) {
346        try {
347            return Optional.ofNullable(
348                ServerUtils.startOrConnectToExistingServer(
349                    explicitPort,
350                    buildDir.resolve(PORT_FILE_NAME),
351                    serverSettingsDirectory,
352                    accessToken,
353                    resolveServerClasspath(),
354                    clientTimeout,
355                    serverIdleTimeoutMinutes,
356                    serverFactory
357                )
358            );
359        } catch (Exception e) {
360            log.error("Error starting Micronaut Test Resources service", e);
361            return Optional.empty();
362        }
363    }

365    private List<File> resolveServerClasspath() throws DependencyResolutionException {
366        List<MavenDependency> applicationDependencies = Collections.emptyList();
367        if (classpathInference) {
368            applicationDependencies = getApplicationDependencies();
369        }
370        Stream<Artifact> serverDependencies =
371            TestResourcesClasspath.inferTestResourcesClasspath(applicationDependencies, testResourcesVersion)
372                .stream()
373                .map(DependencyResolutionService::testResourcesDependencyToAetherArtifact);
374
375        List<org.apache.maven.model.Dependency> extraDependencies =
376            testResourcesDependencies != null ? testResourcesDependencies : Collections.emptyList();
377
378        Stream<Artifact> extraDependenciesStream = extraDependencies.stream()
379            .map(DependencyResolutionService::mavenDependencyToAetherArtifact);
380
381        List<Artifact> artifacts = concat(serverDependencies, extraDependenciesStream).toList();
382
383        var resolutionResult = dependencyResolutionService.artifactResultsFor(artifacts.stream(), true);
384        var thinServer = resolutionResult.stream()
385            .map(ArtifactResult::getArtifact)
386            .filter(artifact -> isTestResourcesArtifact(artifact, "server-thin"))
387            .findFirst();
388        if (thinServer.isPresent()) {
389            // Resolve the thin server as the primary distribution, with its own runtime dependencies.
390            var thinServerArtifacts = concat(Stream.of(thinServer.get().setFile(null)), artifacts.stream()
391                .filter(artifact -> !isTestResourcesArtifact(artifact, "server")
392                    && !isTestResourcesArtifact(artifact, "server-thin")));
393            var thinRuntime = dependencyResolutionService.artifactResultsFor(thinServerArtifacts, true);
394            return toClasspathFiles(thinRuntime.stream()
395                .filter(result -> !isTestResourcesArtifact(result.getArtifact(), "server"))
396                .toList());
397        }
398        var filteredArtifacts = resolutionResult.stream()
399            .filter(result -> {
400                var artifact = result.getArtifact();
401                var id = new ModuleIdentifier(artifact.getGroupId(), artifact.getArtifactId());
402                return TestResourcesClasspath.isDependencyAllowedOnServerClasspath(id);
403            })
404            .toList();
405        return toClasspathFiles(filteredArtifacts);
406    }
407
408    private static boolean isTestResourcesArtifact(Artifact artifact, String module) {
409        return DependencyResolutionService.TEST_RESOURCES_GROUP.equals(artifact.getGroupId())
410            && (DependencyResolutionService.TEST_RESOURCES_ARTIFACT_ID_PREFIX + module).equals(artifact.getArtifactId());
411    }
412
413    private List<MavenDependency> getApplicationDependencies() {
414        return this.mavenProject.getDependencies().stream()
415            .map(DependencyResolutionService::mavenDependencyToTestResourcesDependency)
416            .toList();
417    }

419    /**
420     * Contains the logic to stop the Test Resources Service.
421     *
422     * @param quiet Whether to perform logging or not.
423     */
424    public void stop(boolean quiet) throws MojoExecutionException {
425        if (!enabled) {
426            return;
427        }
428        if (shared) {
429            try (var ignored = sharedServerLock(getServerSettingsDirectory())) {
430                stopSharedServer(quiet);
431            }
432            return;
433        }
434        stopServer(quiet);
435    }
436
437    private void stopSharedServer(boolean quiet) throws MojoExecutionException {
438        if (releaseSharedServerUse(getServerSettingsDirectory())) {
439            try {
440                cleanupSharedProjectSettings();
441            } catch (IOException e) {
442                throw new MojoExecutionException("Unable to clean shared test resources settings", e);
443            }
444            log("Keeping Micronaut Test Resources service alive for another parallel reactor module", quiet);
445            return;
446        }
447        stopServer(quiet);
448    }
449
450    private void stopServer(boolean quiet) throws MojoExecutionException {
451        if (isKeepAlive()) {
452            log("Keeping Micronaut Test Resources service alive", quiet);
453            return;
454        }
455        try {
456            Optional<ServerSettings> optionalServerSettings = ServerUtils.readServerSettings(getServerSettingsDirectory());
457            if (optionalServerSettings.isPresent()) {
458                if (isServerStarted(optionalServerSettings.get().getPort())) {
459                    log("Shutting down Micronaut Test Resources service", quiet);
460                    doStop();
461                } else {
462                    log("Cannot find Micronaut Test Resources service settings, server may already be shutdown", quiet);
463                    Files.deleteIfExists(getServerSettingsDirectory().resolve(PROPERTIES_FILE_NAME));
464                }
465                cleanupSharedProjectSettings();
466            }
467        } catch (Exception e) {
468            var message = "Unable to stop test resources server";
469            if (quiet) {
470                log.warn(message, e);
471            } else {
472                throw new MojoExecutionException(message, e);
473            }
474        }
475    }
476
477    private void logSharedMode(Path serverSettingsDirectory) throws IOException {
478        if (sharedServerNamespace != null) {
479            log.info("Test Resources is configured in shared mode with the namespace: " + sharedServerNamespace);
480            Path projectSettingsDirectory = serverSettingsDirectoryOf(buildDirectory.toPath());
481            Files.createDirectories(projectSettingsDirectory);
482            Path source = serverSettingsDirectory.resolve(TEST_RESOURCES_PROPERTIES);
483            Path target = projectSettingsDirectory.resolve(TEST_RESOURCES_PROPERTIES);
484            Files.copy(source, target, StandardCopyOption.REPLACE_EXISTING);
485        } else {
486            log.info("Test Resources is configured in shared mode");
487        }
488    }
489
490    private void writeSharedScopeConfiguration() throws IOException {
491        String scope = sharedScope();
492        if (scope == null) {
493            return;
494        }
495        Path testClassesDirectory = testOutputDirectory(mavenProject, buildDirectory);
496        Files.createDirectories(testClassesDirectory);
497        updateApplicationTestProperties(testClassesDirectory.resolve(APPLICATION_TEST_PROPERTIES), scope);
498        log.info("Using Micronaut Test Resources scope " + scope + " for " + moduleKey());
499    }
500
501    static Path testOutputDirectory(MavenProject mavenProject, File buildDirectory) {
502        if (mavenProject != null && mavenProject.getBuild() != null) {
503            String testOutputDirectory = mavenProject.getBuild().getTestOutputDirectory();
504            if (testOutputDirectory != null && !testOutputDirectory.isBlank()) {
505                return Path.of(testOutputDirectory);
506            }
507        }
508        return buildDirectory.toPath().resolve("test-classes");
509    }
510
511    static void updateApplicationTestProperties(Path file, String scope) throws IOException {
512        Properties properties = new Properties();
513        if (Files.exists(file)) {
514            try (InputStream input = Files.newInputStream(file)) {
515                properties.load(input);
516            }
517        }
518        properties.setProperty(TEST_RESOURCES_SCOPE_PROPERTY, scope);
519        try (OutputStream output = Files.newOutputStream(file)) {
520            properties.store(output, "Generated by micronaut-maven-plugin");
521        }
522    }
523
524    static String sanitizeScopeSegment(String value) {
525        String sanitized = value.replaceAll("[/\\\\]+", ".")
526            .replaceAll("[^A-Za-z0-9_.-]", "-")
527            .replaceAll("[.]{2,}", ".")
528            .replaceAll("-{2,}", "-");
529        sanitized = trimScopeDelimiters(sanitized);
530        return sanitized.isEmpty() ? "root" : sanitized;
531    }
532
533    private static String trimScopeDelimiters(String value) {
534        int start = 0;
535        int end = value.length();
536        while (start < end && isScopeDelimiter(value.charAt(start))) {
537            start++;
538        }
539        while (end > start && isScopeDelimiter(value.charAt(end - 1))) {
540            end--;
541        }
542        return value.substring(start, end);
543    }
544
545    private static boolean isScopeDelimiter(char c) {
546        return c == '.' || c == '-';
547    }
548
549    private String sharedScope() {
550        if (!shared || mavenProject == null) {
551            return null;
552        }
553        Path multiModuleDirectory = mavenSession.getRequest().getMultiModuleProjectDirectory() == null
554            ? null
555            : mavenSession.getRequest().getMultiModuleProjectDirectory().toPath().toAbsolutePath().normalize();
556        Path projectDirectory = mavenProject.getBasedir() == null
557            ? null
558            : mavenProject.getBasedir().toPath().toAbsolutePath().normalize();
559        String projectSegment = mavenProject.getArtifactId();
560        if (multiModuleDirectory != null && projectDirectory != null && projectDirectory.startsWith(multiModuleDirectory)) {
561            Path relativePath = multiModuleDirectory.relativize(projectDirectory);
562            if (relativePath.getNameCount() > 0) {
563                projectSegment = relativePath.toString();
564            }
565        }
566        return sessionState().scopePrefix + "." + sanitizeScopeSegment(projectSegment);
567    }
568
569    private boolean registerSharedServerUse(Path serverSettingsDirectory, int port, boolean serverStarted) {
570        if (mavenProject == null) {
571            return false;
572        }
573        synchronized (SESSION_STATE_MONITOR) {
574            Path key = normalize(serverSettingsDirectory);
575            SessionState sessionState = sessionState();
576            SharedServerState sharedServerState = sessionState.sharedServers.get(key);
577            if (serverStarted) {
578                sharedServerState = new SharedServerState(port);
579                sessionState.sharedServers.put(key, sharedServerState);
580            } else if (sharedServerState == null || sharedServerState.port != port) {
581                return false;
582            }
583            sharedServerState.owners.add(moduleKey());
584            return true;
585        }
586    }
587
588    private boolean releaseSharedServerUse(Path serverSettingsDirectory) {
589        if (mavenProject == null) {
590            return false;
591        }
592        synchronized (SESSION_STATE_MONITOR) {
593            SessionState sessionState = SESSION_STATES.get(mavenSession);
594            if (sessionState == null) {
595                return false;
596            }
597            SharedServerState sharedServerState = sessionState.sharedServers.get(normalize(serverSettingsDirectory));
598            if (sharedServerState == null) {
599                return false;
600            }
601            sharedServerState.owners.remove(moduleKey());
602            if (!sharedServerState.owners.isEmpty()) {
603                return true;
604            }
605            sessionState.sharedServers.remove(normalize(serverSettingsDirectory));
606            return false;
607        }
608    }
609
610    private SessionState sessionState() {
611        synchronized (SESSION_STATE_MONITOR) {
612            return SESSION_STATES.computeIfAbsent(mavenSession, ignored -> new SessionState());
613        }
614    }
615
616    private String moduleKey() {
617        if (mavenProject == null || mavenProject.getBasedir() == null) {
618            return buildDirectory.toPath().toAbsolutePath().normalize().toString();
619        }
620        return mavenProject.getBasedir().toPath().toAbsolutePath().normalize().toString();
621    }
622
623    private static Path normalize(Path path) {
624        return path.toAbsolutePath().normalize();
625    }
626
627    static SharedServerLock sharedServerLock(Path serverSettingsDirectory) {
628        Path key = normalize(serverSettingsDirectory);
629        ReentrantLock lock = SHARED_SERVER_LOCKS.computeIfAbsent(key, ignored -> new ReentrantLock());
630        return new SharedServerLock(key, lock);
631    }
632
633    static int sharedServerLockCount() {
634        return SHARED_SERVER_LOCKS.size();
635    }
636
637    private static void releaseSharedServerLock(Path key, ReentrantLock lock) {
638        lock.unlock();
639        if (!lock.isLocked() && !lock.hasQueuedThreads()) {
640            SHARED_SERVER_LOCKS.remove(key, lock);
641        }
642    }
643
644    private void createKeepAliveFile() throws IOException {
645        Path keepalive = getKeepAliveFile();
646        createKeepAliveDirectory();
647        if (Files.exists(keepalive, LinkOption.NOFOLLOW_LINKS)) {
648            if (!Files.isRegularFile(keepalive, LinkOption.NOFOLLOW_LINKS)) {
649                throw new IOException("Keepalive path exists but is not a regular file: " + keepalive);
650            }
651        } else {
652            Files.writeString(keepalive, "true", StandardOpenOption.CREATE_NEW);
653            Runtime.getRuntime().addShutdownHook(new Thread(() -> {
654                try {
655                    deleteKeepAliveFile();
656                } catch (MojoExecutionException e) {
657                    // ignore, we're in a shutdown hook
658                }
659            }));
660        }
661    }
662
663    private void createKeepAliveDirectory() throws IOException {
664        synchronized (SESSION_STATE_MONITOR) {
665            Path keepAliveDirectory = sessionState().keepAliveDirectory;
666            if (Files.exists(keepAliveDirectory, LinkOption.NOFOLLOW_LINKS)) {
667                if (!Files.isDirectory(keepAliveDirectory, LinkOption.NOFOLLOW_LINKS)) {
668                    throw new IOException("Keepalive directory exists but is not a directory: " + keepAliveDirectory);
669                }
670                return;
671            }
672            try {
673                FileAttribute<?>[] attributes = keepAliveDirectoryAttributes(keepAliveDirectory.getParent());
674                if (attributes.length == 0) {
675                    Files.createDirectory(keepAliveDirectory);
676                } else {
677                    Files.createDirectory(keepAliveDirectory, attributes);
678                }
679            } catch (FileAlreadyExistsException e) {
680                if (!Files.isDirectory(keepAliveDirectory, LinkOption.NOFOLLOW_LINKS)) {
681                    throw new IOException("Keepalive directory exists but is not a directory: " + keepAliveDirectory, e);
682                }
683            }
684        }
685    }

687    private static boolean isServerStarted(int port) {
688        if (System.getProperty("test.resources.internal.server.started") != null) {
689            return Boolean.getBoolean("test.resources.internal.server.started");
690        } else {
691            return !SocketUtils.isTcpPortAvailable(port);
692        }
693    }

695    private void log(String message, boolean quiet) {
696        if (quiet) {
697            if (log.isDebugEnabled()) {
698                log.debug(message);
699            }
700        } else {
701            log.info(message);
702        }
703    }

705    private void doStop() throws IOException, MojoExecutionException {
706        try {
707            Path settingsDirectory = getServerSettingsDirectory();
708            ServerUtils.stopServer(settingsDirectory);
709        } finally {
710            deleteKeepAliveFile();
711        }
712    }
713
714    private void deleteKeepAliveFile() throws MojoExecutionException {
715        if (Files.exists(getKeepAliveFile(), LinkOption.NOFOLLOW_LINKS)) {
716            try {
717                Files.delete(getKeepAliveFile());
718            } catch (IOException e) {
719                throw new MojoExecutionException("Failed to delete keepalive file", e);
720            }
721        }
722        tryDeleteKeepAliveDirectory();
723    }
724
725    private Path getServerSettingsDirectory() {
726        if (shared) {
727            return ServerUtils.getDefaultSharedSettingsPath(sharedServerNamespace);
728        }
729        return serverSettingsDirectoryOf(buildDirectory.toPath());
730    }
731
732    private Path getKeepAliveFile() {
733        return sessionState().keepAliveDirectory.resolve("keepalive-" + mavenSession.getRequest().getBuilderId());
734    }
735
736    private void tryDeleteKeepAliveDirectory() throws MojoExecutionException {
737        Path keepAliveDirectory = sessionState().keepAliveDirectory;
738        try {
739            Files.deleteIfExists(keepAliveDirectory);
740        } catch (DirectoryNotEmptyException ignored) {
741            // Another keepalive file in the same session still owns the directory.
742        } catch (IOException e) {
743            throw new MojoExecutionException("Failed to delete keepalive directory", e);
744        }
745    }
746
747    @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
748    private static FileAttribute<?>[] keepAliveDirectoryAttributes(Path directory) {
749        try {
750            if (directory == null || !Files.getFileStore(directory).supportsFileAttributeView("posix")) {
751                return new FileAttribute[0];
752            }
753            return new FileAttribute<?>[]{
754                PosixFilePermissions.asFileAttribute(PosixFilePermissions.fromString("rwx------"))
755            };
756        } catch (IOException | UnsupportedOperationException | SecurityException e) {
757            return new FileAttribute[0];
758        }
759    }
760
761    private void cleanupSharedProjectSettings() throws IOException {
762        if (shared && sharedServerNamespace != null) {
763            Path projectSettingsDirectory = serverSettingsDirectoryOf(buildDirectory.toPath());
764            Files.deleteIfExists(projectSettingsDirectory.resolve(TEST_RESOURCES_PROPERTIES));
765        }
766    }
767
768    private Path serverSettingsDirectoryOf(Path buildDir) {
769        return buildDir.resolve("../.micronaut/test-resources");
770    }

795    static final class SharedServerLock implements AutoCloseable {
796        private final Path key;
797        private final ReentrantLock lock;
798
799        private SharedServerLock(Path key, ReentrantLock lock) {
800            this.key = key;
801            this.lock = lock;
802            this.lock.lock();
803        }
804
805        @Override
806        public void close() {
807            releaseSharedServerLock(key, lock);
808        }
809    }
